title: Cross-Market Meta-Learning for Electricity Price Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.17387v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Day-ahead (DA) electricity price forecasting is usually posed per market, with a separate model fitted to each grid's own history. This caps accuracy: statistical and tree-based baselines saturate, while higher-capacity sequence models need more training data than a single market's few years of hourly prices can supply. Such methods also treat each node as an independent series, discarding the spatial dependencies induced by network topology and congestion. Because price formation across independent system operators (ISOs) is driven by shared physics and largely common market design, we instead treat cross-market history as a pretraining corpus. We present MetaGrid, a topology-aware transformer, meta-trained across markets so that a single zone-count-independent parameter set adapts to an unseen grid. translated_title: 跨市场元学习电力价格预测
translated_abstract: 日前（DA）电力价格预测通常按单个市场进行，即为每个电网自身的历史数据拟合单独的模型。这限制了预测精度的提升：统计方法和基于树的基线模型已趋于饱和，而更高容量的序列模型所需的训练数据超出了单一市场仅有的几年小时级价格数据所能提供的规模。此外，这类方法还将每个节点视为独立的时间序列，丢弃了由网络拓扑和输电阻塞所引起的空间依赖关系。鉴于独立系统运营商（ISO）之间的价格形成由共享的物理规律和基本相同的市场设计驱动，我们转而将跨市场的历史数据视为预训练语料库。我们提出了MetaGrid，一个具备拓扑感知能力的transformer模型，通过跨市场元训练，使一套与区域数量无关的单一参数集能够适应未见过的电网。在五个美国ISO的无数据泄漏基准测试中（每个模型都接收相同的价格、日前负荷预测和日历特征），MetaGrid……
tldr: 该论文提出MetaGrid——一个拓扑感知的transformer模型，通过跨市场元学习将多个ISO市场的历史数据作为预训练语料，使一套与区域数量无关的参数集能够适应未见过的电网，从而突破单市场数据不足对日前电力价格预测精度的限制。
en_tdlr: MetaGrid, a topology-aware transformer meta-trained across multiple ISO markets, enables a single zone-count-independent parameter set to adapt to unseen grids, overcoming the data limitations of single-market day-ahead electricity price forecasting.
